metaDescription: Specialist Jaguar V6 ignition coil and timing chain/belt repair for AJ-V6 and AJD-V6 engines. Full workshop process, fixed-price quotes, and nationwide recovery.
h1: Jaguar V6 Ignition Coil & Timing Repair
lede: Precision ignition and timing system repairs for Jaguar AJ-V6 and AJD-V6 engines — carried out in our Essex workshop with full testing and warranty.

blocks.html: Our workshop handles ignition coil and timing system repairs on both petrol and diesel Jaguar V6 engines. The work covers:

items: **Petrol AJ-V6 engines** — replacement of ignition coils and spark plugs (requiring intake manifold access), and timing chain replacement with new tensioners and guides.
**Diesel AJD-V6 engines** — timing belt replacement, including tensioner and idler rollers, using manufacturer-specified locking tools.
Full post-repair testing, including on-road validation, to confirm correct operation.
We use genuine or OEM-equivalent parts and follow Jaguar workshop procedures for every repair.

blocks.html: [Learn more about our workshop](/about) and how we approach every V6 engine service.

paras: **Full V6 engine rebuilds start from £2,900 (diesel) and £3,200 (petrol).** For specific ignition coil or timing repairs, we provide a fixed-price quote after a no-obligation inspection. [Request a quote](/contact) or [see our pricing policy](/pricing-legal-disclaimer).

blocks.html: These repairs apply to Jaguar models equipped with the naturally aspirated AJ-V6 petrol or the AJD-V6 diesel engine family. Select your model below to see detailed engine information.
Specific variants we regularly work on:

steps.title: Vehicle Arrival & Inspection
steps.body: We receive your Jaguar, perform a visual check, and confirm the scope of work based on your description.

steps.title: Component Access
steps.body: For petrol V6 engines, we lift the intake manifold to access the rear-bank ignition coils and spark plugs. For diesel engines, we remove front covers and auxiliary components to reach the timing belt.

steps.title: Removal & Replacement
steps.body: We replace ignition coils and spark plugs (petrol) or timing belt/chain, tensioners, and guides (both) using the correct locking tools and torque settings.

steps.title: Reassembly & Testing
steps.body: Components are refitted, the engine is started, and we run full operational checks – including road testing – to ensure perfect function.

steps.title: Handover & Warranty
steps.body: We present the completed work with a detailed invoice, and all repairs come with our 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

items.q: Do you repair both petrol and diesel V6 engines?
items.a: Yes. We work on the naturally aspirated AJ-V6 petrol (found in X-Type, S-Type, XF) and the AJD-V6 diesel (found in S-Type, XF, XJ).

items.q: Is the ignition coil replacement a straightforward job?
items.a: On the petrol V6, accessing the rear-bank coils requires lifting the intake manifold, which adds time. We perform this carefully using proper lifting methods and new gaskets where needed.

items.q: How long does a timing chain or belt replacement take?
items.a: Typically 1–2 days, depending on the engine and any additional components that need replacement. We provide a time estimate when we quote.

items.q: Do you use genuine Jaguar parts?
items.a: We use genuine or OEM-equivalent parts. All components are sourced from reputable suppliers and come with their own warranty.

items.q: Is there a warranty on the repair work?
items.a: All our repairs come with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Full details are available on our [warranty page](/warranty).
